basis: Botulinum toxin causes neuromuscular junction failure; ocular, swallowing and respiratory manifestations reflect neural blockade rather than intrinsic organ damage.
Umbrella of mitochondrial organic acid disorders; neurologic, ocular and cardiac damage vary substantially by subtype and are not uniform across the group.
Defined by impaired small-intestinal nutrient absorption; associated deficiencies do not establish another commonly damaged organ across this umbrella.
Developmental delay in 5/5 and seizures in 3/5; VSD/PDA each in 2/5; camptodactyly in 2/5 supports skeletal involvement. Hirsutism is not skin damage.
Parathyroid hyperfunction; skeletal mineral loss affects at least about 30%. Kidney stones are a separate disease and occur in a minority.
Benign tumors arise in subcutaneous tissue; extension between muscles, tendons and joint capsules explicitly occurs without infiltrating those structures.
Developmental speech-sound production disorder falls within the neurodevelopmental axis; no structural oral or airway disease is established.
Primary tumor of breast parenchyma, which has no axis; distant metastases are not defining involvement of this concept.
Transient thyroid hormone deficiency of prematurity; lasting neurologic damage is not established as a common direct feature of this self-limiting condition.
Aural atresia, intellectual disability and VSD define it; skeletal abnormalities 30-79%. Anal malformation 80-99% and strabismus 30-79% omitted by cap.
Intestinal lymphatic dysfunction causes protein-losing enteropathy; direct enteric lymphocyte loss causes lymphopenia in 30-79%. Underlying cardiac/hepatic diseases are separate.
Short-rib thoracic dysplasia with defining pulmonary hypoplasia and respiratory insufficiency. Isolated pyloric stenosis and patent foramen ovale do not justify additional axes.
Hereditary neonatal epilepsy syndrome; no additional organ disease is established.
Intellectual disability, microcephaly and epilepsy with defining scoliosis and delayed skeletal maturation. Hirsutism does not establish skin damage.
Broad disorder defined by disrupted organic acid metabolism; no specific additional organ damage applies across the entire concept.
Psychiatric mood disorder; the definition's reference to the brain does not establish neurologic organ damage under the no-axis rule.
Defined by metabolic consequences of poorly controlled childhood diabetes and glycogenic hepatopathy; growth failure does not establish intrinsic skeletal disease.
Cardiac septal, eyelid/eye and radial defects define it; anal atresia/malposition are defining and occur in 30-79%. Hearing abnormalities 30-79% omitted by cap.
Anti-MOG-associated immune-mediated demyelination of brain and spinal cord; optic involvement is not established as common in this ADEM-specific phenotype.
Cobalamin metabolic defect with defining megaloblastic anemia and neurodevelopmental disease; retinopathy in 80-99%. Nonspecific cardiac morphology omitted under cap.
Annular eruption of infancy classified as a dermis disorder; no established systemic organ damage or specific immune mechanism.
Primary carcinoma of the thyroid gland; thymus-like differentiation describes tumor histology rather than another involved organ.
Defining enchondromatosis and D-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria; developmental delay, renal agenesis and cataract are each occasional (5-29%), so excluded.
Sarcoma originates in a paranasal sinus, included in the pulmonary axis; soft-tissue histology does not establish locomotor-system involvement.
Neurodevelopmental impairment is the common phenotype across pathogenic 14q deletion syndromes; other organ malformations depend on the deleted interval.
